title: Implement peak and RMS input output level meters and drive saturation readout
description:
Create Source/UI/LevelMeters.h and Source/UI/LevelMeters.cpp. Implement a juce::Component subclass named LevelMeters that renders Peak + RMS input and output level meters (with ballistic decay) and a Drive Saturation readout showing peak reduction in dB. The GUI reads instantaneous peak/RMS/reduction telemetry exclusively through std::atomic<float> values that the processor updates on the audio thread; the component runs a Timer to sample those atomics and repaint. It must NEVER lock, block, or call the audio thread. Provide a public API so PluginEditor can bind the atomic telemetry handles, but do not include PluginProcessor here.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (existing atomic peak/RMS I/O and gain-reduction/saturation telemetry members; read only)
- Source/PluginEditor.h (naming conventions and how editor passes telemetry handles)
- JUCE/modules/juce_gui_basics/components/juce_Component.h (do not modify anything under JUCE/)
acceptance_criteria: Source/UI/LevelMeters.h and Source/UI/LevelMeters.cpp exist and declare/define class LevelMeters deriving from juce::Component
LevelMeters renders peak and RMS input/output meters with decay ballistics and a drive saturation (peak reduction) readout
LevelMeters reads telemetry only through std::atomic values and never locks or calls the audio thread
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost_VST3 succeeds after adding these files to the target sources
No file outside this task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify CMakeLists.txt (g.5 owns the CMake integration)
lock, block, or call the audio thread from GUI code
